guide.title: The Blue Ridge Parkway from Shenandoah to Cherokee
guide.author: friends of Placemoir
guide.summary: Five days down all 469 miles of the parkway, from Rockfish Gap in Virginia to the Great Smoky Mountains, with overlooks, short hikes, old mills and lodges. Sections close for weather and repairs; check NPS road status.
sections: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi
Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi
Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi
Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Humpback Rocks
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 6, Lyndhurst, VA 22952
places.notes: The first real climb south of Rockfish Gap: a short, steep trail from Humpback Gap to a bare rock summit over the Shenandoah Valley. The visitor center and pioneer farm buildings are just up the road at milepost 5.8.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Ravens Roost Overlook
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 10.7, Lyndhurst, VA 22952
places.notes: A cliff-edge pullout facing west over the Shenandoah Valley and Torry Mountain. Rock climbers use the ledge; everyone else comes for the late-afternoon light.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Devils Backbone Basecamp Brewpub
places.address: 200 Crandall Run, Roseland, VA 22967
places.notes: A big timber-frame brewpub in the Rockfish Valley, down VA-664 from Reeds Gap. A good lunch or dinner stop, with a lawn out back and a campground nearby run by the same brewery.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Crabtree Falls
places.address: 11581 Crabtree Falls Hwy, Tyro, VA 22976
places.notes: A string of cascades dropping more than 1,000 feet, reached by a short detour down VA-56 from milepost 27. The lower overlook is a few minutes from the lot; the full climb to the top takes a couple of hours round trip.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Yankee Horse Ridge
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 34.4, Vesuvius, VA 24483
places.notes: A pullout with a rebuilt stretch of narrow-gauge logging railroad and a short walk to Wigwam Falls. A quick leg-stretch on the way down to the James River.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Natural Bridge State Park
places.address: 6477 S Lee Hwy, Natural Bridge, VA 24578
places.notes: A 200-foot limestone arch over Cedar Creek, about a half-hour off the parkway near the James River crossing. The creekside trail runs under the bridge past Saltpeter Cave to Lace Falls. Worth the detour if you have a spare afternoon.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: James River Visitor Center
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 63.6, Big Island, VA 24526
places.notes: The parkway's lowest point, where it crosses the James. A footbridge under the road leads to a restored lock from the old James River and Kanawha Canal. Bridge repair work has brought detours here; check NPS road status.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Sunset Field Overlook
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 78.4, Buchanan, VA 24066
places.notes: Trailhead for Apple Orchard Falls, a 200-foot falls reached by a steep descent through a hardwood cove. Plan on a couple of hours and save energy for the climb back up.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Peaks of Otter Visitor Center
places.address: 85919 Blue Ridge Pkwy, Bedford, VA 24523
places.notes: Ranger desk and exhibits at the foot of Sharp Top. From here you can walk to the restored Johnson Farm or loop around Abbott Lake.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Sharp Top Trail
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 86, Bedford, VA 24523
places.notes: A stiff climb up stone steps to the rocky summit of Sharp Top, with a full circle of views across the Piedmont and the ridges. Start early on fall weekends, when the lot fills.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Peaks of Otter Lodge
places.address: 85554 Blue Ridge Pkwy, Bedford, VA 24523
places.notes: The only lodge on the Virginia side of the parkway, set on Abbott Lake with every room facing the water and Sharp Top. The dining room is the one sit-down meal for miles. Seasonal; book well ahead for October.
places.section: Day 1 · Rockfish Gap to Peaks of Otter · 86 mi

places.name: Explore Park
places.address: 3900 Rutrough Rd, Vinton, VA 24014
places.notes: A county park along the Roanoke River at milepost 115 with a parkway visitor center, trails, river access, and cabins, yurts and campsites for an inexpensive night near the road.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Mill Mountain Star
places.address: 2404 Prospect Rd SE, Roanoke, VA 24014
places.notes: Roanoke's giant neon star on Mill Mountain, reached by a spur road from milepost 120. The overlook takes in the whole city; come back after dark to see it lit.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: The Hotel Roanoke & Conference Center
places.address: 110 Shenandoah Ave NW, Roanoke, VA 24016
places.notes: The Tudor-style railroad hotel across the tracks from downtown, built in the 1880s and still the city's grand old address. A pedestrian bridge leads straight into the Market district.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Texas Tavern
places.address: 114 W Church Ave, Roanoke, VA 24011
places.notes: A ten-stool hot dog and chili counter that has been feeding downtown Roanoke since 1930. Order a cheesy western and a bowl of chili, and expect to wait for a seat.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Floyd Country Store
places.address: 206 S Locust St, Floyd, VA 24091
places.notes: Old-time and bluegrass music hub in the town of Floyd, about six miles off the parkway on VA-8. Weekend shows pack the floor with flatfoot dancers; check the official site for the music calendar.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Hotel Floyd
places.address: 300 Rick Lewis Way, Floyd, VA 24091
places.notes: A small hotel built with green materials a short walk from the Country Store, with rooms named for and furnished by local artists and craftspeople. Handy if you want to stay for a night of music.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Rock Castle Gorge Trail
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 167, Floyd, VA 24091
places.notes: A long, demanding loop that drops from the open meadows of Rocky Knob into a deep gorge and climbs back. For a shorter outing, walk only the grassy ridgetop stretch along the parkway.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Chateau Morrisette
places.address: 291 Winery Rd SW, Floyd, VA 24091
places.notes: A winery just off milepost 171.5 in a big timber-frame building, with a restaurant and tastings. Reservations are a good idea for a meal.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Mabry Mill
places.address: 266 Mabry Mill Rd SE, Meadows of Dan, VA 24120
places.notes: The gristmill on a millpond that ends up on half the parkway postcards. A short path passes a blacksmith shop and other farm buildings. The parkside restaurant has been closed for renovation; check before counting on a meal here.
places.section: Day 2 · Peaks of Otter to Mabry Mill · 90 mi

places.name: Puckett Cabin
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 189.9, Meadows of Dan, VA 24120
places.notes: The log cabin of Orelena Puckett, a midwife who delivered babies across these hills into the 1930s. A two-minute stop with a good story attached.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Blue Ridge Music Center
places.address: 700 Foothills Rd, Galax, VA 24333
places.notes: Exhibits on the fiddle and banjo traditions of the region, with local musicians often playing on the breezeway and an outdoor amphitheater for summer concerts. Check the official site for the schedule.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Cumberland Knob
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 217.5, Ennice, NC 28623
places.notes: Just past the North Carolina line, the first recreation area built on the parkway. An easy loop climbs to the knob, and the Gully Creek trail drops into a ravine for something harder.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Brinegar Cabin
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 238.5, Laurel Springs, NC 28644
places.notes: A homestead cabin and garden at Doughton Park, where the meadows open up on both sides of the road. Good place to watch for deer at dusk.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: The Bluffs Restaurant
places.address: 45338 Blue Ridge Pkwy, Laurel Springs, NC 28644
places.notes: A parkway coffee shop dating to 1949, with a curved counter and country cooking, reopened with help from the Blue Ridge Parkway Foundation. It is seasonal and has run on limited days, so check its site before planning lunch around it.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: E. B. Jeffress Park
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 271.9, Deep Gap, NC 28618
places.notes: Trailhead for the Cascades, a short loop through rhododendron to viewing platforms beside a long slide of water down a rock face. Stay behind the railings; the rock is slick.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: The Blowing Rock
places.address: 432 The Rock Rd, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: The cliff that gave the town its name, where updrafts out of the Johns River Gorge can push light objects back up. Privately run since the 1930s, with a view to Grandfather Mountain.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Blowing Rock Art & History Museum
places.address: 159 Ginny Stevens Ln, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: A compact museum just off Main Street with rotating shows of Appalachian art and the town's history as a mountain resort. A good rainy-day stop.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: The Speckled Trout
places.address: 922 Main St, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: A long-running Main Street restaurant where mountain trout is the dish to order. Easy to walk to from most of the town's inns.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Green Park Inn
places.address: 9239 Valley Blvd, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: A white clapboard hotel from the late 1800s sitting right on the Eastern Continental Divide. Old-fashioned rooms, a wide porch and the Divide Tavern, which straddles the line.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Chetola Resort
places.address: 185 Chetola Lake Dr, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: A lakeside resort on an old estate at the edge of town, a short walk from Main Street and a few minutes from Moses Cone. The splurge stay of the trip.
places.section: Day 3 · Mabry Mill to Blowing Rock · 116 mi

places.name: Moses H. Cone Memorial Park
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 294, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: Flat Top Manor, a 1901 summer house with a long porch facing Bass Lake, now holds a craft shop of the Southern Highland Craft Guild. Miles of old carriage roads wind around the estate for walking or riding.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Price Lake
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 297, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: A still mountain lake with Grandfather Mountain reflected in it on calm mornings. A flat trail loops all the way around the shore.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Julian Price Park Campground
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 297, Blowing Rock, NC 28605
places.notes: The parkway's biggest campground, with lakeside tent sites and an easy walk to Price Lake. The budget way to sleep near Blowing Rock; reserve through Recreation.gov.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Linn Cove Viaduct
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 304, Linville, NC 28646
places.notes: The S-curved concrete bridge that wraps the side of Grandfather Mountain, the last piece of the parkway finished, in 1987. The Tanawha Trail passes underneath for the classic view from below.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Grandfather Mountain
places.address: 2050 Blowing Rock Hwy, Linville, NC 28646
places.notes: Privately run nature park with the Mile High Swinging Bridge, wildlife habitats and steep trails along the ridge. The entrance is on US-221 about a mile south of milepost 305. Wind and ice can close the mountain; check the official site.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Linville Falls
places.address: Linville Falls Spur Rd, Linville Falls, NC 28647
places.notes: The falls where the Linville River drops into Linville Gorge. The spur road and trails have reopened after Helene, but some facilities nearby, including the campground and picnic area, remain closed; check the NPS site.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Famous Louise's Rock House Restaurant
places.address: 23175 Linville Falls Hwy, Linville Falls, NC 28647
places.notes: A 1930s stone tavern where three counties meet, serving country breakfasts, ribs and homemade pies. A short hop from the Linville Falls exit.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Switzerland Inn
places.address: 86 High Ridge Rd, Little Switzerland, NC 28749
places.notes: A Swiss-chalet style inn in the old resort village of Little Switzerland, reached from milepost 334, with rooms looking off the edge of the ridge. South of here the parkway has had long Helene repair closures; check NPS road status for the detour.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Mount Mitchell State Park
places.address: 2388 NC-128, Burnsville, NC 28714
places.notes: The highest summit east of the Mississippi, reached by NC-128 from milepost 355. A short paved path climbs from the summit lot to an observation deck. The park closes often in winter, and the top can be much colder than the valleys.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Craggy Gardens Visitor Center
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 364.5, Barnardsville, NC 28709
places.notes: Grassy balds covered in rhododendron. A trail from the visitor center climbs to the bald, and the Craggy Pinnacle trail starts from a lot just north for a ring of views. Some trails and the picnic area may be closed; check the NPS site.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Folk Art Center
places.address: 382 Blue Ridge Pkwy, Asheville, NC 28805
places.notes: Home of the Southern Highland Craft Guild, with a gallery of historic Appalachian crafts and a shop selling work by guild members. Craftspeople often demonstrate in the lobby.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: The Omni Grove Park Inn
places.address: 290 Macon Ave, Asheville, NC 28804
places.notes: The granite-boulder resort from 1913 on Sunset Mountain, with fireplaces big enough to stand in and a terrace looking over the city to the Blue Ridge. Stop in for a drink at sunset even if you sleep elsewhere.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Cúrate
places.address: 13 Biltmore Ave, Asheville, NC 28801
places.notes: Downtown Spanish tapas bar with a long counter facing the kitchen. Book ahead, or try for a seat at the bar.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: French Broad Chocolate Lounge
places.address: 10 S Pack Sq, Asheville, NC 28801
places.notes: Truffles, cakes and drinking chocolate on Pack Square. The line moves faster than it looks.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Sunny Point Café
places.address: 626 Haywood Rd, Asheville, NC 28806
places.notes: West Asheville's breakfast institution, with a kitchen garden out front and biscuits worth the wait. Fuel up here before the last day.
places.section: Day 4 · Blowing Rock to Asheville · 90 mi

places.name: Blue Ridge Parkway Visitor Center
places.address: 195 Hemphill Knob Rd, Asheville, NC 28803
places.notes: The parkway's main visitor center at milepost 384, with a long wall map of the whole road and rangers who know current closures. Good place to plan the final stretch.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
places.address: 20 Fredrick Law Olmsted Way, Asheville, NC 28806
places.notes: Gardens, a bonsai collection and miles of trails in Bent Creek, right off milepost 393. Easy to spend a morning.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Mount Pisgah Trail
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 407.6, Canton, NC 28716
places.notes: A rocky, steepening climb of about a mile and a half from the Mount Pisgah parking area to the summit beside the broadcast tower. Views reach back toward Asheville across land George Vanderbilt once owned.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Pisgah Inn
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 408.6, Canton, NC 28716
places.notes: A ridgetop motor inn whose rooms look east over the Pisgah forest, with a restaurant facing the same view. Open spring through fall; meals need reservations, so book early.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Looking Glass Rock Overlook
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 417, Brevard, NC 28712
places.notes: A pullout facing the bare granite dome of Looking Glass Rock, which shines when wet. One of the easiest big views of the day.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Graveyard Fields
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 418.8, Canton, NC 28716
places.notes: A high valley of blueberry thickets and waterfalls, with a short walk to Second Falls and a longer one to Upper Falls. The lot overflows on fall weekends; arrive early or late.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Devil's Courthouse
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 422.4, Brevard, NC 28712
places.notes: A short, steep paved trail to a rock summit where you can see into four states on a clear day. Peregrine falcons nest on the cliffs, so parts may close in spring.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Richland Balsam Overlook
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 431.4, Sylva, NC 28779
places.notes: The highest point on the whole parkway, just over 6,000 feet. The self-guiding trail from the Haywood-Jackson Overlook just north loops through spruce-fir forest that feels more like New England than North Carolina.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Waterrock Knob Visitor Center
places.address: Blue Ridge Pkwy, Milepost 451.2, Waynesville, NC 28786
places.notes: A small visitor center with one of the widest views on the road, looking toward the Great Smoky Mountains. A short, steep trail climbs to the summit.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Oconaluftee Visitor Center
places.address: 1194 Newfound Gap Rd, Cherokee, NC 28719
places.notes: Just past the parkway's end at milepost 469, the Great Smoky Mountains entrance. Next door the Mountain Farm Museum gathers log farm buildings, and elk often graze the fields at dawn and dusk.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Museum of the Cherokee People
places.address: 589 Tsali Blvd, Cherokee, NC 28719
places.notes: The Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians' museum, telling the tribe's history in its own voice, from early life in these mountains through removal and the present. Formerly the Museum of the Cherokee Indian.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi

places.name: Native Brews Tap & Grill
places.address: 1897 Tsali Blvd, Cherokee, NC 28719
places.notes: A Native-owned grill on the main road through Cherokee, with burgers, trout and beer on tap. A relaxed dinner at the end of the road.
places.section: Day 5 · Asheville to Cherokee · 87 mi
